title: Authentication Security Audit
objectives: Identify security vulnerabilities in authentication system
Implement proper security measures and best practices
Understand common attack vectors and mitigation strategies
Apply secure coding principles to authentication flows
requirements: Audit the provided intentionally vulnerable authentication system
Identify and document at least 5 security vulnerabilities
Implement fixes for identified security issues
Add proper input validation and sanitization
Add rate limiting and brute force protection
Ensure passwords are properly hashed and salted
stretchGoals: Add audit logging for security events
Add security headers and HTTPS enforcement
constraints: Start with the provided vulnerable baseline implementation
Document each vulnerability found with explanation
Maintain backward compatibility with existing API endpoints
Use only native Node.js modules or well-established security libraries
